parsed.title: Incorrect read-set for plan-from-issue
parsed.detail: When a unit is routed via `plan-from-issue`, the `readSetFor` call uses `docs/fix` as the directory and an empty array for `selected` rows, but passes `['README.md']` as the `base`. The `readSetFor` function attempts to join `docs/fix` with `README.md` resulting in `docs/fix/README.md`. However, `readSetFor` also calls `citedPaths(rows)`, and since `rows` is empty, it only returns the base files. If the intention was to include the fix index, the logic is correct, but the `unit` property in the printed output is `clean` (the number), while the `unit.slug` is used elsewhere, creating a potential mismatch in how the unit is identified in the printed record vs the command.

parsed.title: Inconsistent unit identification in output
parsed.detail: In the `plan-from-issue` branch (line 258), the `print` function is called with `unit: clean`. In all other branches (line 278), `unit: unit.slug` is used. This means for issues, the `unit` field in the stdout will be the numeric ID, whereas for folders, it is the slug. This contradicts the expectation that the `unit` field identifies the unit consistently across all routes.
